The book "BROKEN: His Life Was Valuable, Before He Lived It." seems to provide a compelling personal story and examination of morality surrounding the pro-life movement. 

According to the detailed product information, the book follows the lives of two women - a pro-life activist and a young woman who takes her advice - over 18 years in a small Texas town. The description suggests the book explores complex moral issues in a way that impacts both women's lives. 

With a 5-star average rating based on 2 reviews, and a low price point of $4.74, this book could be a good option that aligns with your interest in finding an advice-oriented book within your budget. Let me know if you would like any other details about this title.
